text:
maria: Thinking out loud — we need a small, predictable schema for Optimize quant profiles that maps cleanly to rollout metadata. current bakeoffs spit out a lot of ad-hoc fields. can we agree on a minimal manifest + surface for consumer hints?

kai: yes. +1 to minimal. idea: two layers — profile metadata (stable) + runtime hints (best-effort). keep compatibility predicates explicit. :eyes:

maria: sketch: 
```
manifest_version: "1"
profile_id: "optz-awq-llama2-13b-fp8-v0"
model_family: "llama-2"
variant: "13b"
quant_backend: "awq"
quant_bits: "fp8"
accuracy_delta: "-0.4%"
perf_delta: "+1.9x"
compat_predicates: ["max_seq<=2048", "runtime in [runtime-v2,runtime-edge]"]
surface_hints: {"recommended_route": "dedicated", "fallback_profile": "optz-int8-llama2-13b-v0"}
```

devin: put surface_hints keys as flat strings instead of nested JSON to match our DB. e.g. "surface:recommended_route":"dedicated". reduces parsing in Console.

olga: we should include a stable semantic version string separate from profile_id, so we can bump metadata without changing id. e.g. semver: "0.1.0" and an immutable fingerprint.

maria: agree on semver + fingerprint. fingerprint can be sha256 of canonical manifest. helps consumers verify integrity.

kai: also include an optional "eval_contexts" array so Optimize can show which evals were run: short names like "chat-llm-eval-v2", "summ-bench-1". keep it small.

maria: good. and add a "rollout_policy" shorthand for Console to wire canary rules: e.g. "rollout_policy":"canary:5%->30%:7d"

devin: question: how to encode acceptable accuracy delta? numeric threshold vs human label? propose two fields: "max_accuracy_regression": "0.75%" and "quality_signals": ["terse:semantic-similarity", "long:rlhf-sanity"]

olga: sounds good. we should also standardize naming so Optimize recommendations can rank profiles: a simple ranking key like "unit_cost_score":"0.82" and "latency_p50_ms":"78". all numbers as strings in the manifest for simplicity.

quant-ci-bot: bakeoff run finished 1718802600 — best profile: optz-awq-llama2-13b-fp8-v0 (accuracy_delta=-0.38%, perf=1.92x). artifacts: s3://redwood-bakeoffs/1718802600/optz-awq-llama2-13b-fp8-v0/manifest.json :thumbsup:

maria: next steps: 1) finalize minimal manifest fields 2) add sample canonical serialization and fingerprint tooling 3) update Optimize importer to accept both legacy qpack and new manifest.

kai: I'll PR a json-schema draft by EOD today. will include a migration tool to generate semver and fingerprint.

devin: I'll prototype Console UI mapping: how rollouts and fallback_profile surface in the model route page.

olga: I'll write a short doc on compatibility predicates (examples and common pitfalls).

maria: thanks. if anyone has objection to flat surface_hints vs nested let me know now, otherwise we'll go flat. :thumbsup: 

kai: flat is fine. tiny follow-up: name registry rules — profiles must live under namespace "optimize/<model_family>/<variant>/<profile_id>". enforced on ingest.

maria: noted. final ask: keep manifest <= 2KB uncompressed for fast reads.

devin: ack.

olga: ack.
